newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan machinery orders still on rising trend - EPA.
newsitem.headline: Japan machinery orders still on rising trend - EPA.

text.p: Japan's machinery orders remain basically on a rising trend despite a drop in August, an official of the Economic Planning Agency said on Tuesday.
The EPA earlier said that private sector machinery orders, excluding those for machinery at electric power firms and for ships, fell 11.1 percent in August from the previous month.
The official told reporters the August drop was a reaction to the previous month's rise. Private sector machinery orders were up 13.6 percent in July from the previous month.
"The figure is a reaction to July and the general trend is on a gradual increase," the official said.
The August figures which show a year-on-year increase of 11.4 percent indicate that the general trend is on the rise, the official said.
Machinery orders for the July-September quarter are likely to be within the EPA forecast of an 8.2 percent quarter-on-quarter drop, he said.
